q.line: See as much as we can stand, stand till we stagger
stanza: Sometimes it's hard to know when to call it an evening
See as much as we can stand, stand till we stagger
Laying all twisted together and exposed
Like roots on a river bank

partner.line: Like roots on a river bank

q.line: So we struggle and we stagger
